comment: Source read at commit 5c6f38d. Every one of the nineteen commits says version 2.0.0, so the installed art settled it: res/layout.svg matches only the last three commits (6f28461, eeaa2ec, 5c6f38d), and the differences between those three are an include, the spelling of pi and a Makefile flag, so all three behave alike. The six CV inputs are not summed with their knobs: module.hpp:242-283 calls setDisplayValue on the parameter and then subtracts the parameter's new value from the same figure, so the offset added in process is always zero and the CV works only by moving the knob, which it also saves into the patch. BUTTON_INPUT, input index 7, is read at module.hpp:133 but was never given a configInput or a PortWidget, so it has no name and no jack. The button carries no printed name on the panel; the maker's tooltip calls it Let it out.
